targetAudience: PMs and buyers evaluating AI agents
topic: How to measure real autonomy instead of marketing autonomy
coreInsight: An agent’s real autonomy is measured by how often a human has to step in per task and how much time each intervention costs, not by the label on the product.

hookVariants.text: Count the times a human steps in.

selectedHook: Count the times a human steps in.
selectionRationale: Highest total (23/25): names the one measure that cuts through autonomy claims, which the checklist turns into a simple log.

script.onScreen: THE AUTONOMY LOG / Track per task, every week. / Interventions: approvals, fixes, restarts · Minutes of human time per intervention · Share of tasks done with zero help · Split it by task type, trend it weekly / Real autonomy is the share of tasks done with no human help.
script.voiceover: For every task, log interventions: approvals, fixes and restarts. Log the minutes each one costs. Track the share of tasks finished with zero help. Split by task type and trend it weekly.

script.onScreen: EXAMPLE (ILLUSTRATIVE) / The label vs the log. / THE LABEL Sold as “fully autonomous” · THE LOG 1.8 interventions per task · THE LOG 6 minutes per intervention · THE LOG 1 in 5 tasks need no help
script.voiceover: Illustrative example: sold as fully autonomous. The log says 1.8 interventions per task, six minutes each, and only one in five tasks done with no help.

script.onScreen: Measure the help it still needs. / Save this for your next agent review
script.voiceover: Measure the help it still needs. Save this for your next agent review.

caption:
“Autonomous” is a label. Interventions per task is a measurement.

Log this for every agent task:
→ Interventions: approvals, fixes, restarts
→ Minutes of human time per intervention
→ Share of tasks finished with zero help
→ Split by task type, trend it weekly

Real autonomy is the share of tasks done with no human help, plus what the remaining help costs. Ask vendors for the same numbers.

(The 1.8 interventions, 6 minutes and 1-in-5 figures in the reel are illustrative, not from a real product.)

Save this for your next agent review.
